### Session dc1f101d-5d19-4c27-9ef0-adc1c738651b - 2026-07-30T05:02:53.361Z

- **User wanted:** Diagnosis of why the n8n lead-routing workflow failed, and a fix recommendation

- **Claude Code discovered:** A silent critical failure — Visit Notes workflow has been broken since July 24 (seven consecutive nightly run failures), with no alert sent; the root cause is a dead Jobber OAuth2 credential in n8n that's unrelated to the leads failure

- **Root cause identified:** Jobber refresh tokens don't rotate on refresh, but re-authorizing the app issues a new token that invalidates the old one; since n8n and local CLI tooling share one Jobber app, they're in a token-conflict loop — when one re-authorizes, the other dies

- **Two solutions offered:** (1) Long-term: create a separate Jobber app just for n8n so credentials can't conflict; (2) Fast alternative: reconnect the existing n8n credential now, accepting some risk to the CallRail sync

- **Setup steps provided:** Register new Jobber app in Developer Center, get OAuth callback URL from n8n, wire up credentials, point both workflows to new credential; also noted that the existing Jobber app still needs read+write Requests scope for the website-form feature

- **Recommendation:** Take ten minutes to do it properly rather than ping-pong between failures; once Jobber auth is fixed, Gmail step should work (that credential is already configured and waiting)
